entities.summary: Ismaël Sindou Kamagate is an Ivorian-French professional basketball player for Beşiktaş Gain of the Basketbol Süper Ligi (BSL) and the EuroCup. His draft rights are retained by the Los Angeles Clippers of the National Basketball Association (NBA).
